videos.title: How Salesforce uses Claude Code
videos.description:
Salesforce scaled Claude Code to thousands of engineers and doubled effective output, with fewer bugs per line of code than before.

Engineering leaders from Salesforce explain how they measure AI coding ROI with an "effective output" score built with Stanford researchers, and how an agent maturity curve moved engineers from simple prompts to autonomous agents across the software development life cycle. They also cover a decades-old codebase made headless in weeks instead of a year, a marketplace for sharing agent skills, incident agents that find the right team automatically, and a bug that Claude Opus tracked down in 24 hours after human attempts failed.

More here: https://claude.com/office-hours#salesforce

Chapters
0:00 Making Salesforce headless in weeks, enabling Claudeforce
1:31 Measuring ROI with "effective output"
3:18 The agent maturity curve, from prompts to autonomy
5:53 Driving adoption with live demos and real data
7:30 Building a skills marketplace with evals
9:07 Guardrails: double the code volume, fewer bugs
10:18 Replaying benchmarks to test new models
11:37 "Autonomy without validation is confidence theater"
12:44 How big a task to give an agent
13:52 Biggest mistake: matching model to task
15:13 Advice for engineers and CTOs

analysis.summary: 動画では、AI技術がビジネス環境や開発の現場にどのように取り入れられているかが議論されています。参加者たちは具体的なエピソードを交えながら、ツールの有効性や自動化の可能性について語り合っています。新たな取り組みや課題についての意見交換が行われ、開発プロセスにおける変化が強調されています。最終的に、今後の展望や改善すべき点についての前向きな意見が交わされました。
